description: BuildTheIdea - Collaboratively build an idea about {topic} together as a group

actions.action_goal: {"id": "build_the_idea_{topic_id}", "description": "Start with a seed idea about {topic} and have the group build on it together.", "success_criteria": [{"id": "c1", "description": "{robot_name} introduces the challenge: Let's plan {topic} together.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c2", "description": "One participant contributes an idea.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}, {"id": "c3", "description": "{robot_name} keeps participants engaged for {discussion_time}.", "reached": false, "evidence": null}], "timeout": {"max_time": {"minutes": 5, "seconds": 0}, "max_turns": null}, "additional_instructions": ["Address the group as a whole.", "Stay neutral - don't judge opinions.", "Encourage everyone to contribute.", "React to what participants say, connect ideas, and keep responses short."]}

topic.description: What to build together (e.g., 'the perfect party', 'an ideal vacation', 'a fun weekend')

discussion_time.description: How long to continue the discussion (e.g., '2 minutes', '90 seconds')
